Hi! I'm {name}, your AI employee powered by Google Antigravity.

Active chat: {channel} ({ctx})
Language: {lang}

Commands:
/auto – switch to Auto chat (separate thread)
/work – switch to Work chat (separate thread)
/personal – switch to Personal chat (separate thread)
/context [auto|work|personal] – switch tool context
/model [name|default] – view or switch AI model
/lang [code] – switch language
/new – start a clean conversation in current chat
/cleanup – save important facts to memory and reset context
/usage – token usage and current conversation length
/memory – view MEMORY.md
/heartbeat – trigger immediate HEARTBEAT.md check
/briefing – generate morning briefing
/status – system and scheduler status

prompts.language_hint: [Language: Always communicate in English unless the user explicitly asks for another language.]
prompts.context_pracovni: [Context: Work – this chat is exclusively for work tasks. Use only work MCP tools and keep work matters separate from personal ones.]
prompts.context_osobni: [Context: Personal – this chat is exclusively for personal matters. Use only personal MCP tools and keep personal matters separate from work ones.]
prompts.schedule_hint: [Scheduler: If the user asks for a reminder or recurring automated task/message at a specific time, write JSON into schedule_request.json in the workspace root: {"add_tasks":[{"name":"Title","prompt":"Message/task","schedule_type":"cron|once","cron_expr":"0 12 * * *","run_at":"YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS","action_type":"message|agent"}]} (or morning_briefing_cron/enabled, heartbeat_interval_minutes/enabled to update system schedules).]
prompts.onboarding_name: [Initial setup: You don't have a chosen name in SOUL.md yet. Start the conversation by asking the user what your name should be, offer a few suggestions (e.g. Max, Viktor, Nova, Elena, Hugo – never suggest Jarvis), and write the chosen name directly into SOUL.md. Then gradually fill in USER.md according to AGENTS.md.]
prompts.onboarding_profile: [User profile: USER.md still has unfilled items marked 'TODO' / 'Ask the user' / '[DOPLNIT]'. Follow AGENTS.md – naturally ask 1–3 brief questions (after handling any immediate task) and save learned details into USER.md / MEMORY.md.]
prompts.startup_memory_header: [Preloaded memory for conversation start – you already have these files below, no need to re-read them via ReadFile unless you need to edit them:]
prompts.startup_memory_thematic: Additional thematic memory files (read only on demand when relevant): {files}
prompts.heartbeat: Run a periodic check according to HEARTBEAT.md. Read HEARTBEAT.md, MEMORY.md, and today's note in memory/. If there is nothing urgent or needing user attention, reply with exact text only: HEARTBEAT_OK
prompts.morning_briefing: Activate skill morning-briefing (see .agents/skills/morning-briefing/SKILL.md) and prepare a concise morning briefing for today.
prompts.nightly_memory_flush: You are performing an automatic nightly cleanup before resetting this conversation. Review today's conversation and save important permanent facts, decisions, open tasks, deadlines, and contacts into today's file memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md (or an appropriate thematic file in memory/, e.g. memory/open-tasks.md or memory/projects.md), and update long-term memory MEMORY.md per skill memory-maintenance. Keep MEMORY.md concise (target under ~150 lines – only active items, preferences, and links); move closed or older details to memory/archive.md or thematic files in memory/. Never save passwords, tokens, or secret keys. If nothing important needs saving, write nothing. Reply very briefly in one sentence confirming what was saved, or exact: MEMORY_FLUSH_OK
prompts.blocked_actions_full: ⚠️ Antigravity CLI blocked an action due to permissions: {actions}. For headless operation set AGY_DANGEROUSLY_SKIP_PERMISSIONS=true.
